# Supervised Learning
    Supervised ML trains algorithms on labeled datasets, meaning each input has a known correct output, to learn patterns and predict outcomes for new data.

Email Dataset - Email Text, Sender Email, Link, Exclamations, Label

input values -> Email Text, Sender Email, Link, Exclamations
output values -> Label


data(2d array) -> ML -> model

Features -> Columns
1. Independent (input values)
2. Dependent (output values)


- Step-1 --> Data -> preprocess + feature engineering (encoding)
- Step-2 --> Select Model
- Step-3 --> Train/Test  (80,20)
- Step-4 --> underfit or overfit problems solving

## Types of problems
1. **Regression** - output is a continuous numerical value (weather,aqi,stock price,marks,car price)
2. **Classification** - output is a category or class(spam/non-spam, cat/dog/rabbit, lenign/malignant, digits recognition)
   1. Binary Classification
   2. Multi-Class Classification
   3. Multi Label Classification
